records.context: A daemon thread takes one reading every ``interval`` seconds into a ring buffer of ``capacity`` samples, so a run that lasts a week cannot grow the log without limit and still leaves the most recent hour when it dies.

records.source: A daemon thread takes one reading every ``interval`` seconds into a ring buffer of ``capacity`` samples, so a run that lasts a week cannot grow the log without limit and still leaves the most recent hour when it dies.
records.translation: Bakgrunnsþráður tekur eina mælingu á ``interval`` sekúndna fresti og geymir hana í hringbiðminni sem rúmar ``capacity`` sýni. Þannig getur vikulöng keyrsla ekki látið annálinn vaxa án takmarkana, en þegar hún stöðvast varðveitast samt gögn síðustu klukkustundarinnar.
